separation_basis: A separately authorized read-only reviewer found the legacy recovery mapping issue and independently re-reviewed the fixed snapshot; the reviewer made no edits and did not run tests.
scope: S01 local metric composition and legacy recovery-watch compatibility after the shared MOD-17 question-library change.

initial_finding.summary: Legacy manifests could supply a rewritten top-level replacement map used by recovery observations without metric-contract validation.
initial_finding.resolution: Rebuild mappings from each question record’s replaces metadata, cross-check the declared index, and mark recovery watch needs_verification with replacement_mapping_unverified when mappings drift or are incomplete. Core summaries retain legacy behavior.

scope_limitations: Approval applies to local S01 deterministic contracts and the reviewed source snapshot.
